name: Finland: no road toll or vignette
law: Traficom, the agency that collects Finland's vehicle tax, states on its vehicle tax page that time-based road user charges (vignettes), distance-based road tolls and vehicle emission stickers are not used in Finland. Vehicles registered in Finland pay the yearly vehicle tax instead, not a charge for using the roads (not modelled). The page gives no date from which this holds: valid_from is the day it was first read.

sources.title: Traficom (Finnish Transport and Communications Agency): Vehicle tax

no_charge: no road toll, vignette or emission sticker for trucks (Traficom: they are not used in Finland).
